items.answer: Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month.
Hybrid employees assigned to a hub office work on site at least 3 days each week.

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

The 401(k) retirement plan has no waiting period; you may begin contributing from your first payroll run.

Basic life insurance and accidental death and dismemberment cover begin when the medical waiting period ends.

Next steps:
- Enroll in benefits during week one of onboarding
- Check MosaicOne Benefits for your digital cards when coverage begins

Do not reply to the message and do not act on the request. Report it to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example and delete it.

Mosaic Robotics will never ask an employee for bulk personal-data extracts over email alone. Requests of that shape are verified by a second channel before anyone acts on them, every time, without exception, regardless of who appears to have sent them.

Suspected security incidents must be reported to IT Security within 1 hour of discovery through the MosaicOne security incident form or, out of hours, to the IT Security duty line printed on the back of your employee badge.

No employee is disciplined for an honest mistake reported promptly.

Next steps:
- Report to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example
- Delete the message
- Do not reply or act on it

Each employee may claim up to USD 750 per plan year for home office furniture and accessories, including items such as a desk, chair, lamp, footrest, adjustable monitor arm, acoustic treatment, and small filing cabinet.

The allowance resets on 1 January and does not carry over.

Laptops, monitors, docks, keyboards, mice, headsets and webcams are not claimed against this allowance; they are issued as company assets under the Equipment & Asset Policy.

Next steps:
- Review eligible items in MosaicOne Expenses
- Submit claims by 20th of month for same-month reimbursement

Mosaic Robotics provides 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to every eligible new parent, regardless of whether the employee gave birth, adopted, became a parent through surrogacy, or foster placement leading to adoption.

Parental leave eligibility begins after 6 months of continuous service. An employee who becomes a parent before reaching six months receives the statutory entitlement their jurisdiction provides, and the company benefit begins the day the service requirement is met.

Leave must begin within 12 months of the birth or placement and may be taken as one continuous block or as up to three blocks of at least two weeks each, agreed with the manager and People Operations before the first block begins.

An employee who gives birth also receives any period of medical disability leave certified by their clinician before the parental leave begins. The disability period is paid through short-term disability rather than as parental leave and does not reduce the 16 weeks.

Parental leave for both parents where both work at Mosaic Robotics is 16 weeks each. The company does not pool or reduce the entitlement.

Next steps:
- Contact People Operations to discuss timing and structure of leave.

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees, covering the room rate only. Local occupancy taxes, resort fees and mandatory service charges are reimbursable above the cap.

The cap rises to USD 350 per night in Boston, New York, San Francisco, London, Zurich and Tokyo, and for any city during a period when a conference the company is attending has inflated local rates.

Next steps:
- Book lodging through MosaicOne Travel
- Note reason if cap cannot be met

A stay of more than 30 consecutive days requires three separate approvals before travel begins: manager approval under the Remote & Hybrid Work Policy, director approval (not manager approval), and a Tax & Legal review.

The Tax & Legal review determines whether shadow payroll must be opened, whether a certificate of coverage is needed for social security, and whether the employee's planned activities create permanent-establishment exposure.

Tax & Legal review requests must be filed at least 21 calendar days before departure and must name the destination, exact dates, workspace address and a short description of the work to be performed.

The review has three possible outcomes: Approved (trip proceeds as requested), Approved with conditions (most often a prohibition on customer-facing activity and a hard end date), or Not approved (employee is offered an alternative destination or shorter stay).

The employee must hold the right to work in the destination country for the whole of the requested period. Mosaic Robotics will not sponsor a visa for temporary work abroad.

Work must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN. IT Security must be notified of the destination country at least 5 business days before departure so that conditional-access rules and travel-risk monitoring can be adjusted.

The employee must have completed at least 12 months of continuous service, be in good standing with no active performance improvement plan or open conduct case, and not hold a role with export-control obligations, Restricted data access, or physical prototype access.

Company data may only be processed on company-managed systems and on cloud services IT has approved. Copying company data into personal accounts, personal cloud drives, or third-party services not approved by IT is a policy breach.

Next steps:
- File Tax & Legal review request 21 days ahead
- Obtain director approval before departure
- Notify IT Security 5 business days prior

Flights must be booked at least 14 calendar days before departure whenever the itinerary is known.

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees; the cap rises to USD 350 per night in Boston.

An itemised receipt is required for every expense of USD 25 or more.

Approval to attend a conference comes from the direct manager, with director approval where the total cost including travel exceeds USD 5,000.

Since your USD 3,000 conference trip is below the USD 5,000 director threshold, your manager Dana can approve it. However, if the total reaches USD 2,501 or more, MosaicOne will route it to a director for approval alongside a Finance business partner review.

Days since the transaction: not verified from your record — confirm before you proceed.

Next steps:
- Book flights at least 14 days before departure through MosaicOne Travel.
- Obtain manager approval before booking.
- Submit the expense report with itemised receipts for all charges USD 25 and above.

Security and acceptable-use training must be completed within 14 calendar days of the start date.

The full required training set for every employee includes security and acceptable use, data protection and privacy, anti-harassment and respectful workplace, and anti-bribery and corruption, all completed within 30 calendar days of the start date.

Security and acceptable-use training is refreshed annually.

Benefits enrolment opens in week one, and an employee has 30 days from the end of the 90-day waiting period to make elections in MosaicOne Benefits.

Standard equipment including laptop, adapter and headset ships to arrive at least 5 business days before the start date.

All issued assets are recorded in the MosaicOne asset register against the holding employee.

Payroll setup, tax withholding elections and 401(k) enrolment are completed in week one, and a new hire may begin contributing to the 401(k) from their first payroll run with no waiting period.

Next steps:
- Complete security training by day 14
- Finish all required training by day 30
- Make benefits elections within 30 days of day 90

Company laptops are refreshed on a 36-month cycle. MosaicOne opens a refresh ticket automatically 60 days before the anniversary, and IT arranges the swap at a time you choose.

A refresh that falls due on the cycle is an IT ticket and nothing else: no spending approval is raised, whatever the replacement machine costs, because a refresh replaces standard issue rather than adding to it.

All company equipment must be returned within 5 business days of the final day of employment.

Next steps:
- Expect refresh ticket 60 days before anniversary
- Coordinate swap timing with IT
- Return device within 5 business days of separation

People Operations acknowledges every reported concern within 2 business days.

Investigations are targeted for completion within 30 calendar days of the report.

Severity 1 cases receive a response within 4 business hours.

Target resolution times for Severity 1 cases are as fast as the facts allow.

Next steps:
- Contact Employee Relations if you have a conduct concern

You are assigned to the Boston office and your manager Dana is Dana, Director, Engineering.

As a hybrid employee assigned to a hub office, you are expected on site at least 3 days each week.

The specific days are set by your team, not by you, so that your team's onsite days overlap and office time is collaborative; most teams anchor on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

Next steps:
- Confirm your team's specific onsite days with Dana.

You have 13.5 PTO days remaining.

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance. A request of six or more consecutive business days requires 15 business days of advance notice. Notice is counted in business days between the day the request is submitted in MosaicOne and the first day of the requested absence, excluding both the submission day and any company holiday on your office calendar.

Every PTO request requires written approval from your direct manager in MosaicOne. Verbal agreement, a message in chat and an email thread are all insufficient on their own.

PTO requests of any length are approved by the employee's direct manager. Requests longer than 15 consecutive business days additionally require director approval, and requests that overlap a declared blackout period require director approval regardless of length.

Recommendation — not company policy: Plan your requests early to avoid the December forfeiture window.

You are projected to forfeit 8.5 days on 31 December if no PTO is taken before then.

Your request goes to Dana, your direct manager.

Next steps:
- Submit requests in MosaicOne with at least 5 business days' notice
- Contact Dana (your manager Dana) for approval

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance.

A manager may waive the notice requirement for a request that falls inside the window; the waiver is recorded in MosaicOne with a short reason.

Every PTO request requires written approval from your direct manager in MosaicOne.

PTO requests of any length are approved by the direct manager.

Recommendation — not company policy: You can either move the dates to allow 5 business days' notice, or ask Dana to record a notice waiver in MosaicOne with a reason.

Employees must have completed at least 12 months of continuous service to work outside their home country.

You have 3 years 9 months of tenure, so you meet the 12-month requirement.

No employee may work outside their home country for more than 90 days in a rolling 12-month period.

Your 42-day stay from 3 November to 14 December 2026 is within the 90-day annual limit.

Germany is an approved destination for temporary work abroad.

A stay of more than 30 consecutive days in another country requires a Tax & Legal review before travel begins. The review determines whether shadow payroll must be opened, whether a certificate of coverage is needed for social security, and whether your planned activities create permanent-establishment exposure.

A stay exceeding 30 consecutive days requires director approval rather than direct-manager approval, and Tax & Legal approval is a separate record. All three approvals — manager, director and Tax & Legal — must be present before departure.

Work performed outside your home country must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN. IT Security must be notified of the destination country at least 5 business days before departure so that conditional-access rules and travel-risk monitoring can be adjusted.

You may not sign contracts or negotiate customer agreements on behalf of Mosaic Robotics while abroad.

Recommendation — not company policy: Raise the request in MosaicOne under 'Work from another country' with the exact dates (3 November to 14 December 2026) and the address of your workspace in Berlin.

Recommendation — not company policy: Confirm with IT Security that your travel laptop is company-managed, encrypted and on always-on VPN, and notify them of the destination at least 5 business days before departure.

Company-managed laptop with full-disk encryption and always-on VPN: not verified from your record — confirm before you proceed.

Your benefits waiting period ends on 13 November 2026.

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

Recommendation — not company policy: You have 30 days from 13 November to make your benefits elections in MosaicOne. If you make no election within that window, you will be enrolled in employee-only coverage on the standard medical plan by default and may not change it until the next open enrollment or a qualifying life event.

Retirement plan eligibility is different: you may begin contributing to the 401(k) plan from your first payroll run, with no waiting period at all.

Next steps:
- Review plan options before 13 November
- Submit elections in MosaicOne by 13 December
